Signature.description: A JWS (RFC 7515) signature with detached payload. The payload is the JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalisation of this document excluding the Signature field. Supports both compact serialisation (single or multiple signers) and JSON serialisation (multiple signers).

oneOf.title: JWS Compact Serialization (single)
oneOf.description: A single JWS Compact Serialization with detached payload (RFC 7515 Appendix F). Format: BASE64URL(header)..BASE64URL(signature).

oneOf.title: JWS Compact Serialization (multiple)
oneOf.description: An array of JWS Compact Serialization strings, each with detached payload. Use when multiple signers provide independent compact signatures.

oneOf.title: JWS JSON Serialization
oneOf.description: JWS JSON Serialization with detached payload (RFC 7515 §7.2). The 'payload' member is omitted. Supports multiple signatures.

signatures.description: Array of signature objects, each with its own header and signature value.
